summary: Iteration 18 — verified sold-out layout refactor: sold_out retreats now removed from Upcoming grid and rendered in a new 'Sold Out Retreats' section (small tiles via generalized PastExperiencesCarousel). Backend PUT /api/admin/content/retreats flow + all UI test-ids verified end-to-end. Regression: past section renders correctly with defaults; coming_soon and live cards work as expected; admin retreats page loads with SOLD OUT option in status dropdown; smoke pages 200.
critical_code_review_comments: RetreatsPage.jsx is ~855 lines — approaching the >700 line guideline; consider splitting modals (ApplyModal, EnquiryModal) and hero/feedback/instagram sections into subcomponents for maintainability.
normalize() no longer sets soldOut, but the outer template still has a comingSoon path; dead branches previously for sold_out have been correctly removed. No functional issue.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing bali-2026 & gulmarg-2027; DB restored after tests: bali=live, gulmarg=coming_soon)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The public content endpoint /api/content/retreats has a 60s localStorage cache on the frontend (see useContent). After admin mutations, MUST call page.evaluate('localStorage.clear()') then page.reload() before asserting UI state — proven pattern used in this iteration. All key test-ids: upcoming-retreat-{id}, soldout-experiences, soldout-card-{id}, past-experiences, past-card-{id}, hero-cta-soldout, hero-cta-past, hero-cta.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verified working. Note: in one intermediate check, hero-cta-soldout returned False because the detail page was navigated to via in-app click without an additional localStorage clear + reload; a fresh reload confirmed the disabled 'SOLD OUT · BOOKINGS CLOSED' CTA renders correctly and brochure form remains visible.
